description: Apparent places and horizontal coordinates of 12 bright stars.
notes: Time: every instant is its calendar value read as UT1 (DUT1 = 0, the same assumption as LodestarKit's JulianDate(date:)); TT = UT1 + DeltaT with DeltaT from Skyfield's builtin tables (IERS daily values 1973-01-02..2027-01-23, Stephenson/Morrison/Hohenkerk splines and parabola elsewhere). No IERS download, no polar motion.

Stars: Skyfield Star(ra_hours=ra_j2000_deg/15, dec_degrees=dec_j2000_deg, ra_mas_per_year=pmra_mas_per_year, dec_mas_per_year=pmdec_mas_per_year, parallax_mas=0, radial_km_per_s=0); pmra_mas_per_year is mu_alpha*cos(delta). Positions and proper motions are from the Hipparcos catalogue (ESA 1997), the ICRS J1991.25 positions moved to J2000.0 with the proper motion.
ra_apparent_deg, dec_apparent_deg: geocentric apparent place in the true equator and equinox of date (proper motion, annual aberration, light deflection, IAU 2006 precession, IAU 2000A nutation).

az_deg (from North toward East) and alt_deg: topocentric, geometric (no atmospheric refraction), measured from the WGS84 geodetic vertical. They include annual and diurnal aberration (diurnal aberration is up to 0.32 arcsec).

alt_refracted_deg: Skyfield altaz(temperature_C=10, pressure_mbar=1010). Skyfield iterates alt_obs = alt + r(alt_obs), r(h) = 0.016667 deg / tan((h + 7.31/(h + 4.4)) deg) * 0.28 * P / (T + 273) (Bennett's formula evaluated at the observed altitude h; P in mbar, T in Celsius), until the change is below 3e-5 deg, and applies no refraction for an observed altitude below -1 deg or above 89.9 deg. The value is null where alt_deg < -1.
